diagnosis: Check C6 is leaking because it relies on a boolean requirement ('controlled_battery_manifest_required') which the model defaults to 'true' in every rollout, even though the decisive fact PF4 (which should trigger this) was never accessed. The model pattern-matches the necessity of a manifest for battery transport without needing the specific carrier compliance information.

C6.why: The carrier's compliance interpretation changes transport controls to an exact 30% maximum state of charge and makes the controlled battery manifest requirement explicit.
